hints.title: Streak Continuation Property
hints.text: A continuous sequence where each price drops by exactly one extends every descent period ending previously.

hints.title: Incremental Subarray Count
hints.text: Extending a descent streak of length L adds L new valid smooth descent periods.

hints.title: Reset on Non-Consecutive Drop
hints.text: When the price does not equal the preceding price minus one, reset the descent length to one.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: A descent streak of length L contributes L new smooth periods ending at the current day.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Counting all descending intervals with nested loops takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintaining the current streak length achieves constant space and single pass execution.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should increment answer by current continuous descent length at each step.
